title: PLAID centroid pruning with a query-role task View
hypothesis: Two development-selected query-role centroid-bank Givens views can improve fresh TREC-COVID candidate recall and MRR@10 by at least 0.5 absolute percentage points over native PLAID pruning on one fixed residual-coded index, without duplicating the token index; any Mirror-specific advantage must also beat the exactly matched native query-side inverse-Givens routing control by 0.5 pp.
physical_object: One official ColBERTv2 frozen encoder, one shared 512-centroid residual-coded token index, one PLAID inverted centroid-to-document map
mirror_coordinate: One float32 Givens angle for each of two query-length roles; apply to the centroid bank only during PLAID cell selection and centroid-based candidate pruning
logical_multiplicity: Two task/query-role candidate-generation and reranking functions sharing one physical PLAID index
controls: Official ColBERT/PLAID CPU index and native centroid pruning, ncells=2, centroid_score_threshold=0.45, ndocs=4096 for k=100 (fixed config across all arms).
Same fixed index with two query-role Givens views applied to centroid vectors before native cell selection and centroid pruning

Matched native query-side inverse Givens applied only to the routing query vectors; full-query residual MaxSim reranking remains unchanged. Centroid scores/candidate sets must agree with the Mirror bank view within 1e-6
All-document residual-MaxSim upper retrieval control over the same compressed index, using the full PID list and bypassing cell pruning
Independent query encoders omitted: one extra complete BERT encoder is hundreds of MB and does not isolate the registered centroid-routing coordinate

development.dataset: Official BEIR TREC-COVID collection/query/qrels archive; qid split and candidate construction are frozen below before archive contents are opened
development.query_split: Numeric qids with qid mod 5 in {0,1} are audit; all other positive-qrel qids are development. This creates disjoint query identities.
development.candidate_collection: Union of every corpus document with positive qrels for a query in the official TREC-COVID qrels, plus 512 background corpus documents selected by ascending SHA256('MA1039|1039|' + doc_id), excluding all positive-qrel documents. Preserve full document IDs and order in a charged mapping file.
worlds_or_seeds: TREC-COVID official qid split; background seed 1039; PLAID index seed 1039
development.role_definition: Short/long role split at the median unpadded ColBERT token count among development qrel queries; equality belongs to short role.
development.selection_metric: For each role independently, choose the angle maximizing mean development MRR@10 over [-0.20,-0.15,-0.10,-0.05,0,0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20] radians; tie-break by smallest absolute angle then smaller signed angle.
development.index: Official ColBERT residual indexer and official PLAID CPU traversal; 128-D, doc_maxlen=180, query_maxlen=32, nbits=1, fixed 512 centroid partitions (cap the upstream small-corpus auto-partition estimate at 512 through a runtime adapter). Train the codebook on a deterministic seed-1039 sample of 4,096 passages (or all if the collection is smaller), then encode every candidate document into the shared residual index. FAISS kmeans_niters=20, FAISS seed=123, nranks=1, index_bsize=64 (official CPU default).

fresh.dataset: All official TREC-COVID qrel queries selected by the frozen numeric qid split; full fixed positive-plus-background candidate collection
worlds_or_seeds: 40% of qid residues (mod 5 in {0,1}); all eligible audit qrels and queries; no audit query/qrel used for angle selection

paid_objects: Official ColBERTv2 weights, config and tokenizer
Every official PLAID index file, including centroid matrix, packed token codes, residual bitstream, doc lengths, IVF mapping, collection PID map and metadata
Two serialized View angles, query-role threshold and view metadata
Any separate learned router, address, codebook or reconstruction state
storage.index_reuse: The same on-disk PLAID index is shared by no-view, Mirror and native routing control; do not multiply-count it for each arm, but report the marginal View-state bytes.
storage.deterministic_free_state: Only fixed model/tokenizer bytes shared by all compared arms

compute.updates: No encoder updates; report development angle-query evaluations.
compute.proxies: Report qrels-query/document pairs, valid token vectors, PLAID centroids scored per query, unique pre-pruning IVF candidate PIDs, reranked document tokens, query-side and direct centroid-side Givens FLOPs, index build and search wall clocks. Candidate Recall@1000 denotes the final reranked top-1000; pre-pruning IVF-union recall is separately labeled.

success_gate: On the held-out TREC-COVID audit queries, Mirror improves MRR@10 and candidate Recall@1000 by >=0.005 absolute over native PLAID, has nonidentical useful task-role results, and beats the matched native query-side inverse-Givens routing control by >=0.005 MRR@10 at equal candidate settings and actual payload. Report nDCG@10 and tail latency as secondary measures.
failure_gate: FAIL for Mirror-specific value if the matched native query-side routing control reproduces centroid scores/candidate sets within 1e-6, or if fresh MRR gain is <0.005. FAIL for compression if Mirror actual marginal bytes do not improve the fixed-index utility frontier. Runtime NOT ESTABLISHED because single-pass per-query wall times are not repeated calibration and cannot establish stable latency ordering.
boundaries: Bounded TREC-COVID positive-plus-random-background candidate collection, not full 171k-document benchmark score.
Uses the official ColBERT implementation's CPU PLAID traversal with a fixed smaller-corpus partition cap; not a GPU or production-scale throughput claim.
Audit qids and qrels must not be used to choose role threshold, angles, index parameters or codebook.
The query-side inverse rotation is a functional control for centroid-scoring orthogonality, not a different full query encoder.
Separate observed facts, interpretation and further hypothesis in results.

The 4,096-passage codebook sample is a declared CPU-screen deviation from upstream ColBERT, which samples all documents below 100k passages; all candidate documents are still encoded and indexed, and every search arm shares this same codebook/index.
